meta.description: 标准化实验日志记录——直接上传或读取本地图片、语音和文字，产出带 YAML frontmatter 的 Markdown；可选集成飞书 CLI 与 Obsidian。支持多种输入方式（上传、本地文件、飞书群）和输出方式（本地Markdown、Obsidian vault）。

scientific_integrity.detail: Does not guess missing experimental conditions or results. Asks user for clarification on ambiguous data (temperature uncertainty, sample numbering). Structured ID system enables traceability.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for experiment logging and documentation. Does not analyze or interpret experimental results beyond structuring provided data. Clear separation of raw materials (archival) and structured logs (output).

methodological_ground.detail: ID conventions (experiment ID with equipment/system/date, sample batch ID) follow research notebook best practices. Equipment coding and directory structure support reproducibility.

code_usability.detail: Three complete example logs provided (corrosion, electrochemical, thermal stability). Templates for Obsidian integration included. Clear directory structure specification.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive logging workflow: multi-modal input (images, audio, text), structured extraction via vision_analyze, YAML frontmatter generation, raw material archival, optional indexing. Supports both standalone and Obsidian-integrated modes. Minor: lacks explicit support for video input despite mentioning multimodal capability.

reliability.note: Strong quality gates: asks for clarification on ambiguous data, does not guess experimental conditions, structured ID generation prevents duplicates. Minor: lacks validation for ID collision detection across existing logs.

performance_context.note: Efficient processing flow with clear steps. Raw material archival separate from structured output prevents duplication. Minor: no guidance for handling very large image sets (50+ images from microscopy sessions).

agent_usability.note: Clear 8-step workflow. Structured ID conventions well-documented. Equipment coding table provided. Optional integrations (Feishu, Obsidian) clearly separated from core functionality. Minor: lacks decision tree for choosing output mode (local vs Obsidian) when user doesn't specify.

human_usability.note: Good documentation with example logs covering three experiment types. Directory structure visual. Equipment coding table clear. Minor: Chinese-only documentation may limit non-Chinese-speaking users. No English translation provided.

security.note: Local storage by default, no cloud dependency. Feishu CLI integration requires explicit bot permissions (im:message, im:message.group_msg, im:resource). Minor: no explicit guidance for handling sensitive experimental data (proprietary formulations, unpublished results).

maintainability.note: Modular design with core flow independent of optional integrations. Templates and examples separate from skill logic. Clear extension points (system codes, equipment codes, experiment types). Minor: lacks version schema for YAML frontmatter to handle future field additions.

agent_specific.note: Strong multimodal extraction (vision_analyze for images, text parsing). Structured output with YAML frontmatter agent-friendly. Clear confirmation gates for ambiguous data. Minor: lacks explicit guidance for chaining with other nature-* skills (e.g., nature-figure for visualizing time-series logs, nature-statistics for analyzing batch data).

key_strengths: Excellent multimodal input support: images (vision_analyze), audio/voice, text, local files, and Feishu group messages
Strong data integrity: asks for clarification on ambiguous data instead of guessing, distinguishes '未记录' from blank fields
Well-designed ID conventions: experiment ID and sample batch ID enable traceability and cross-experiment tracking via Dataview
Clean separation of concerns: core workflow independent of optional integrations (Feishu, Obsidian), making skill broadly usable
Comprehensive documentation: three complete example logs covering different experiment types, templates for Obsidian integration

recommendations.title: Add experiment ID collision detection
recommendations.problem: Skill generates experiment IDs following {system}-{equipment}-YYMMDD-{seq} convention but does not check for collisions with existing logs before writing. If user runs skill twice for same-day experiments without proper sequencing, IDs may conflict.
recommendations.root_cause: ID generation per workflow step 4 does not include lookup of existing logs to determine next available sequence number.
recommendations.fix: Before generating experiment ID, scan output directory for existing logs matching {system}-{equipment}-YYMMDD-* pattern. Parse sequence numbers, determine max(seq) + 1 as next ID. Report found sequence number to user. Add to workflow step 4: 'Scan existing logs to prevent ID collision.'

recommendations.title: Add bilingual documentation (English translation)
recommendations.problem: All documentation, field names, and directory structure use Chinese exclusively. Non-Chinese-speaking researchers or international collaborations cannot effectively use the skill without translation.
recommendations.root_cause: Skill designed for Chinese-speaking researchers. No internationalization consideration in initial design.
recommendations.fix: Add English translation parallel to Chinese documentation: (1) Create SKILL.en.md with English documentation, (2) Provide English field name mapping in references/field-mapping-en.md, (3) Add language parameter to skill for bilingual output mode (Chinese field names + English comments, or fully English). Keep Chinese as default for backward compatibility.

recommendations.title: Add YAML frontmatter version schema
recommendations.problem: YAML frontmatter structure defined in examples but no version field. Future field additions or restructuring would break existing Dataview queries and parsing scripts without migration path.
recommendations.root_cause: Templates lack schema versioning. No forward-compatibility consideration.
recommendations.fix: Add 'log_version: "1.0"' field to YAML frontmatter in all templates. Document field schema in references/yaml-schema.md with version history. When adding new fields in future versions, increment version and provide migration guide for updating old logs. Include version check in Dataview queries to handle mixed-version logs gracefully.
